title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Urban Green Space and Public Health
prompt: In many rapidly growing cities, the amount of green space available to residents is decreasing, while rates of stress-related illness are rising. Some people argue that local governments should require developers to include a minimum amount of public green space in every new urban project. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this requirement, and what other measures could city authorities take to improve residents' access to green space? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作任务，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读题目，明确题目要求你讨论的两个方面：你是否同意“要求开发商在每个新城市项目中包含最低限度的公共绿地”这一规定，以及城市当局还可以采取哪些其他措施来改善居民接触绿地的机会。写作时请确保立场清晰，并对两方面都做出回应。建议先用几分钟规划文章结构，再开始写作。文章长度不得少于250词。
